_comment: Claude Code plugin hooks. These register the SAME adapter scripts install.sh would wire into ~/.claude/settings.json — the plugin path is just the single-add alternative. ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT} resolves to this plugin's own install dir, so the scripts find core/lib.sh and core/prompts/* next to them exactly as in the checkout (single source of truth, no duplication). Durable output (MEMORY.md, LEARN.log, reflection.log) still goes to ~/.agent-flywheel via $AGENT_FLYWHEEL_HOME, shared across every harness.
